about.text: Gulab jamun is a sweet dessert or mithai which had originated in the Indian subcontinent, and is popular in India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Pakistan and Burmese cuisines.

facts.v: Milk reduced over low heat to khoya, kneaded with a little flour into balls, fried gently in ghee or oil, then soaked in cardamom and rose or saffron syrup
Also eaten in Guyana, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, and Mauritius, as Indo-Caribbean and Indo-Mauritian sweets
